material: APA Rated Sturd-I-Floor48oc PS1 plywood, at least5plies; nominal1-1/8inch, strengthaxisworldZ; stamp/thickness unobserved
reference: APA D510F2020 Table9 printed25-27; axialEA and flatwiseEI are independent published panel stiffnesses. Section4.4.1 explains that publishedEI includes an apparent-shear adjustment. Retained cached primary PDF supplies the source; no new manual copy.

derivation.coordinates: Localg=worldZ,u=worldX,v=worldY. EI_y givesin-planeZ/Y bending; EI_z givesout-of-planeZ/X bending.
derivation.in_plane: EA=publishedEA times8/12ft; EI_y=EA*b²/12 assumesuniformaxiallaminationproperties across8inchwidth. GA_v=publishedGvtv times8inchdepth.
derivation.out_of_plane: EI_z=publishedparallelflatwiseEI times8/12ft. GA_u=1e12N is an explicit near-Euler-Bernoulli approximation using apparentEI, not a published rolling-shear modulus. Short-span/local cut behavior is not qualified.
derivation.torsion: GJ uses a homogeneous rectangle withG=publishedGvtv/nominalthickness and the existing rectangular_torsion formula. This declared torsion surrogate is not a measured laminated torsional rigidity or physical demandbound.
derivation.density: 500kg/m3 nominal mass scenario only; no actual plywood density bound.

limits: Conditional response comparison only; no physical stiffness or load-distribution qualification.
Use a stiffness sensitivity if these unknown modes govern the engineering conclusion.
No transfer of stock DF-L E/G to plywood and no transfer of earlier force fields.
